name: How long does it take to install a custom waterfall?
description: Installation time varies from a few weeks to several months, depending on the waterfall's size, complexity, site conditions, and other factors.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install a custom waterfall?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for installing a custom waterfall depends on its size, complexity, and specific site conditions. Smaller, simpler water features might take a few weeks from design to completion. Larger, more intricate designs involving extensive landscaping, custom stone work, or significant grading can take several weeks to a few months. Factors like weather, material availability, and permit processing can also influence the schedule. We provide an estimated timeline during the design phase and keep you updated on progress.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies from a few weeks to several months, depending on the waterfall's size, complexity, site conditions, and other factors.
